name: Jiaan Guo / Jack Guo
headline: Data Science & Applied ML
introduction: I'm Jiaan Guo, also known as Jack. I'm a New York University undergraduate studying Data Science and Mathematics, expecting to graduate in May 2027. My work spans reproducible data pipelines, applied machine learning, semantic search, and document intelligence. Across internships and personal projects, I focus on turning messy inputs into structured, testable systems and explaining the reasoning behind them. I'm interested in opportunities in data science, applied ML, and data engineering.

education.major: Joint major in Data Science and Mathematics
